headline: Committee recommends Lahaina church rezoning bill as amended, 9-0

meeting.body: Maui County Council Disaster Recovery, International Affairs, and Planning Committee
meeting.voteItem: Friendly amendment to include a land zoning map
meeting.summary: The 9-0 vote covers Bill 94-2026, which would rezone Lahaina United Methodist Church land from R2 Residential to P1 Public/Quasi-Public, with acreage amended to 3.26. A land use zoning map and committee report are needed before first reading.
meeting.recap: The committee took up Bill 94-2026, to rezone Lahaina United Methodist Church land from residential to public/quasi-public use.[[0:06:38]] The church burned down in August 2023 and wants to rebuild.[[0:07:22]] The church's deed shows the land is about 3.26 acres, so the bill needed an amendment.[[0:09:16]] The pastor said the church is holding services on the property again.[[0:10:33]] No one signed up for public testimony.[[0:17:26]] The planning director had concerns about the bill's conditions of zoning, which are extra rules tied to a rezoning.[[0:22:34]] The planning department supports the rezoning because it matches past uses and the community plan.[[0:25:35]] The pastor said a parsonage and a duplex housing two families are on the property.[[0:29:04]] The public works director said combining the two lots could cost about $5,000 to $10,000.[[0:36:07]] The pastor said the church would likely be interested in combining the lots, pending its church council's approval.[[0:36:48]] Amendments changed the acreage to 3.26 acres and used the deed's property description.[[0:50:32]] The amendments passed with nine ayes and zero noes.[[0:53:40]] The main motion, recommending the bill as amended, passed with nine ayes and zero noes.[[0:54:53]] The committee now waits for a land use zoning map and a committee report before first reading.[[0:55:09]]
decided: Members agreed without objection to add a land zoning map to the motion in time for first reading.
meeting.next: A land use zoning map and a committee report are needed before the bill moves to first reading.

moments.q: "it's wonderful to be back in Lahaina"
Deputy corporation counsel recommends removing Section 1 of the bill
Final vote: nine ayes, zero noes

issues.oneLine: Lahaina United Methodist Church, which burned down in August 2023, is seeking a rezoning so it can rebuild.
issues.why: The pastor said the church wants to use the property to benefit the community.
issues.next: The committee is waiting for a land use zoning map and a committee report before first reading.
issues.brief: The bill would change the zoning from R2 Residential to P1 Public/Quasi-Public.[[#1]] The Office of Recovery said required improvements can be handled at the building permit stage.[[#2]] The committee voted nine to zero to recommend the bill as amended.[[#3]]
